summary_en: CCN Group executed a fixed-price acquisition of 5,000 shares at 1,617 yen per share on November 20, 2026 via ToSTNeT-3, totaling 8,085,000 yen or 0.6% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock.
summary_jp: 11月20日、ToSTNeT-3により、基準値段1,617円で5,000株を8,085,000円で取得。発行済株式数（自己株式を除く）906,000株に対する割合は0.6%。

summary_en: 6,000 shares (0.7% of shares outstanding), ¥9.70M aggregate. ToSTNeT-3 off-hours block executed 2026-07-14 at reference price ¥1,617/share. Settlement same day. Results to be disclosed after market close.
summary_jp: 6,000株（発行済株式総数の0.7%）、総額¥9.70M。基準値段¥1,617/株でToSTNeT-3立会外取引により2026-07-14に取得。同日決済、終場後に結果公表。
